management_notes: CEO Tasheel Jeerh (appointed May 2026, replacing founding CEO Conan McIntyre) is leading the company through a post-transition period. President Paul Sobie remains in role. The leadership change introduces ongoing continuity risk, though the exploration mandate appears unchanged: resource delineation at Black Raven and advancing the Golden Baie option. Qualified Person Derek Wilton provides geological continuity across all reported drill programs. Management funded a C$3M private placement in late 2025 to support 2026 drilling — a sign of disciplined treasury management relative to program scale. No insider-ownership breakdown is available from extracted filings; the team lacks a publicly documented discovery-to-resource track record. Score held at 3: competent but unproven at this stage of the project.
geology_notes: Black Raven hosts the historic Frost Cove antimony mine in central Newfoundland (~60 km NW of Gander). Churchill has defined an 800-metre strike at Frost Cove with genuine high-grade intercepts: 7.25% Sb over 1.98m (March 2026 final assays, near Southern Shaft) and 19.23% Sb over 1.40m at Frost Cove North (spring 2026 final assays). A second zone, Pomley Cove Pond, returned a 150-m-wide polymetallic vein swarm with Au-Ag-Mo-Pb-Zn vectors. A third prospect (PC Pond) graded 0.78% Cu and 61.2 g/t Ag over 6.22m. The Golden Baie option (TSXV-approved March 2026) adds another antimony-gold target in the same region. Grade quality at Frost Cove is globally competitive for antimony. Critical missing piece: the NI 43-101 technical report on file dates from August 2023 and pre-dates all 2025–2026 drill results; no updated resource estimate exists. Tonnage and continuity at depth remain unestablished. The extracted tech_43101_source dated 20230801 confirms no updated resource table rows were found in the 43-101 extraction.
capital_notes: Shares issued outstanding of 316,681,940 with 342,756,940 fully diluted (source: April 2026 MD&A, extracted 2026-05-14). The diluted overhang is modest — 2,625,000 warrants and 23,450,000 options (~8.2% dilution) — but strike and expiry details were not extracted from the MD&A summary table. The large absolute share count (316M) is typical for a TSXV explorer funded through multiple equity rounds over several years. No flow-through tranches were detected in the April 2026 MD&A extraction; hold-release overhang from FT shareholders is not flagged as a near-term concern. The Golden Baie option requires minimum C$5M in exploration expenditures within 24 months (at least C$1M in year one) — a committed cash deployment obligation that will require additional equity financings as treasury depletes. At approximately C$0.055 per share, implied market cap is roughly C$17M. Share structure score of 3: workable but the 316M share base limits per-share leverage on a resource estimate.

acquisition_notes: P/NAV cannot be calculated — no NI 43-101 resource estimate exists at Black Raven, and the 2023 technical report pre-dates all recent drill results. The Golden Baie option adds strategic land value but no quantifiable resource. Antimony M&A comparables are thin globally; the critical-mineral designation and supply-chain premium make peer-based valuation difficult. The acquisition case is purely exploration-stage: undiscovered value in a historically mined district with exceptional grade at Frost Cove and a strong commodity price backdrop. If a maiden resource estimate delivers 10–20 Mlbs of contained antimony at grades consistent with the 2026 drill results, comparable critical-mineral transaction multiples suggest significant potential upside — but this remains speculative until the estimate is completed and filed. Score of 2 reflects the complete absence of a quantitative valuation anchor.
analyst_summary: Churchill Resources (CRI.V) is advancing the Black Raven antimony project in central Newfoundland at an inflection point for the antimony market. The 2026 drill campaign delivered world-class results — 19.23% Sb over 1.40m at Frost Cove North — and the company expanded its footprint with the TSXV-approved Golden Baie option (March 2026, minimum C$5M spend obligation). Capital structure is manageable at 316.7M shares issued with ~8.2% diluted overhang from options and warrants; no flow-through hold-release pressure was detected. Antimony prices remain above US$50,000/t driven by Chinese export restrictions, keeping the macro setup compelling for a primary antimony story in a stable, pro-mining Western jurisdiction. As of November 3, 2026, no new material news has been verified (the IR website was unreachable from this session's network; no incremental releases were detected). The company appears to be between field seasons in an inter-season data-processing phase. The critical missing piece remains a NI 43-101 resource estimate at Black Raven; without it, Churchill is a pure exploration story requiring small position sizes to reflect discovery risk. A maiden resource estimate is the single most important re-rating catalyst. Rate WATCH — accumulate on weakness ahead of resource announcement; size positions conservatively until tonnage is established.
